name: Peco Streamline Code 83
description: Peco Streamline HO Code 83 - finer-profile rail (Code 83) intended for North American HO modellers. Code 83 is NOT directly compatible with Code 100 rail joiners; use SL-112 (Code 100/83 transition) joiners. Geometry of turnouts mirrors the Code 100 Streamline range: small/medium/large radius. Flex track 914 mm (36 in) nominal.
